datasheet_identity.title: S5AB THRU S5MB SURFACE MOUNT GENERAL PURPOSE RECTIFIER (SMB Surface Mount General Purpose Rectifier)

extraction_notes: Family datasheet S5AB-S5MB; S5JB ratings: VRRM = VDC = 600 V and VRMS = 420 V; IF(AV) = 5.0 A and IFSM = 150 A at 8.3 ms half-sine are common ratings (p. 1).

The family forward-voltage curve in Fig.3 was digitized from the printed linear-voltage/log-current grid on p. 2. Fig.1 and Fig.2 are thermal/surge ratings. Fig.4 is a normalized reverse-characteristics plot against percent of rated peak reverse voltage and was not used as an absolute-voltage curve.
The high-temperature reverse-current row IR2 = 200 microA at VR = VDC and Ta = 125 degC is recorded here as a note only; the 25 degC leakage row is the model input.
No reverse-recovery time or measured avalanche/breakdown row is published; VRRM is an absolute maximum rating, not a measured breakdown.
